fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami and Miami Beach civic affairs, including warnings about municipal bond issues and city/county debt, criticism of the Miami Chamber of Commerce’s finances and effectiveness, and discussion of seasonal rent increases ahead of November 1. Articles note Miami Beach quality-of-life concerns (frogs, mosquitoes) and question the residency of Justice of the Peace H. W. Penney. Sports coverage centers on the Dempsey–Tunney fight and local boxing cards, alongside society-style columns (e.g., “Little Geraldine”), letters to the editor, and extensive advertising and promotional content (including Coral Gables development statistics).
